Locked in a fierce rivalry, the student council presidents of two elite, warring high schools secretly fall head over heels for each other. To protect their reputations and prevent total campus chaos, the young lovers must constantly outwit their peers and friends in an escalating game of stealth romance. Navigating secret rooftop rendezvous and clandestine dates becomes a hilarious daily struggle as they try to keep their forbidden love a total secret.
